clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Loch Modan, Silver Stream Mine lies between Algaz Station and the Stonewrought Dam, its silver veins exhausted. The Miners' League made the hollow a supply depot, but Tunnel Rat kobolds now occupy its tunnels and hoard stolen equipment and rare minerals.

Silver Stream Mine once yielded rich silver for Ironforge. Dwarf miners dug until the main veins ran dry, leaving broad underground chambers. The Miners' League kept the hard-won shafts in use as a guarded storehouse for tools, mining crates, and regional equipment. The mine is also the only known source of Charged Rift Gems, which draw arcanists seeking delicate tailoring reagents.

Tunnel Rat kobolds came in large numbers and drove the Miners' League caretakers out into the cold of Loch Modan. Now the kobolds guard the stolen dwarf crates with manic fervor. Outside the rear entrances, shattered orcish catapults and wagons lie forgotten, reminders of older frontier skirmishes.
